c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.1.evidence: Fixture: private invite space QA-WALK-B3 Private with a Paid Memberships Pro membership rule (pmpro_3, participate), subscriber admitted by Sync Members. Admin Delete -> confirm modal -> toast 'Access rule deleted.'

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.2.evidence: Next load of the space for the subscriber: 'QA-WALK-B3 Private is invite-only. You need an invitation to join.', gated topic no longer listed, immediately after the delete.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.3.evidence: Subscriber POST /posts/{id}/replies right after -> 404 jetonomy_not_found 'Topic not found.', nothing stored.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.4.evidence: PMPro membership set to expired with enddate yesterday, Membership_Roster_Sync::reconcile() (the hourly job) -> his tier roster row removed (tier rows before: 5, after: 4).

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.5.evidence: With a space follow, a topic follow and a bookmark in the gated space while admitted, after the rule was deleted /subscriptions, /bookmarks and /community/subscriptions|bookmarks|notifications/ no longer list anything from that space and the REST lists are empty. NOTE (separate defect): while admitted by a Role rule WITHOUT a roster row the same member's follows and bookmarks were also missing, see proposed_checks.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.6.evidence: u2 (manual roster member, not admitted by the rule) after the rule was deleted: space page lists the gated topic, POST reply 201.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.7.evidence: His old topic URL -> 404 'Page not available – forums' / 'Topic not found.', identical to a missing topic slug.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.8.evidence: Mailpit for his address holds one email ('varundubey replied in QA-WALK-B3 gated topic', sent while admitted); the reply posted after access ended produced no new email.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.9.evidence: Reply typed in the composer, rule deleted by admin in another context, submit -> inline error 'Topic not found.', typed text still in the editor.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.10.evidence: Membership rule added again by REST: his next load shows the space with the topic and POST reply 201, without pressing Sync.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.11.evidence: Sync Members ('Synced 5 existing members.') then delete the membership rule: tier roster rows for the space dropped to zero immediately (only manual rows left) and the member was refused at once.

c-gating-access-ends-by-itself.12.evidence: After access ended admin replied to his subscribed topic: no new jt_notifications row (latest reply_to_post predates the delete) and no email.

proposed_checks.text: A member admitted only by a Role, Capability, Trust Level or Logged In rule (no roster row) still sees their own follows, bookmarks and reply notifications from that space. FAILS today at 7bbd544b: GET /subscriptions, /bookmarks and the member pages omit them (Space::content_visibility_sql() checks the roster only) and no reply_to_post notification is created for him; adding a manual roster row makes all three appear.
